description: Labelled example prompts the task router compares every query against (nearest-neighbour on embeddings), and that the learned router trains on. Add a line to teach it a phrasing; check the effect with `python -m nexus.evaluate_router`. Never copy prompts from eval/router_set.json or eval/router_golden.json into here.
